frontmatter.sidebar_description: Import products from a CSV file.

blocks.html: This documentation provides a reference to the `importProductsAsChunksWorkflow`. It belongs to the `@medusajs/medusa/core-flows` package.

This workflow starts a product import from a CSV file in the background. It's used by the
[Import Products Admin API Route](https://docs.medusajs.com/api/admin#products\_postproductsimport).

You can use this workflow within your custom workflows, allowing you to wrap custom logic around product import.
For example, you can import products from another system.

The workflow only starts the import, but you'll have to confirm it using the [Workflow Engine](https://docs.medusajs.com/resources/infrastructure-modules/workflow-engine).
The below example shows how to confirm the import.

steps.name: normalizeCsvToChunksStep
steps.description:
This step parses a CSV file holding products to import, returning the chunks
to be processed. Each chunk is written to a file using the file provider.

steps.name: waitConfirmationProductImportStep
steps.description:
This step waits until a product import is confirmed. It's useful before executing the
[batchProductsWorkflow](/references/medusa-workflows/batchProductsWorkflow).

This step is asynchronous and will make the workflow using it a [Long-Running Workflow](https://docs.medusajs.com/learn/fundamentals/workflows/long-running-workflow).

steps.name: notifyOnFailureStep
steps.description:
This step sends one or more notification when a workflow fails. This
step can be used in the beginning of a workflow so that, when the workflow fails,
the step's compensation function is triggered to send the notification.

steps.name: processImportChunksStep
steps.description:
This step parses a CSV file holding products to import, returning the products as
objects that can be imported.

steps.name: sendNotificationsStep
steps.description: This step sends one or more notifications.
